messages:
Maya: Anyone up for a stealth dawn paddle + bakery heist tomorrow? thinking slip out at 5:50am, launch from the harbor, hit the corner bakery before the line. bring headlamps and a tote :kayak: :croissant:
Sam: i am alarmingly willing to sacrifice sleep for carbs. in. :zzz:->:croissant:
Kevin: where's the exact launch? i can strap one on my roof if we need car access. i also have spare ratchet straps.
Olga: straps and cart available. i'll bring a thermos of cold-brew and some plain kombucha for the brave. also i will not judge anyone for stealing extra crumbs. :coffee: :sparkles:
Jin: sadly early plans for me, but brunch sounds great. 10:30 at Little Oven? @Maya if you want i can swing by after and water your fiddle leaf.
Maya: meeting plan: 5:40 meetup at the 3rd St bike rack, roll to the harbor together, launch 5:50. if fog is heavy we'll pivot to brunch at Little Oven at 10:30. Sam can be our designated crumb-taster.
Sam: assigned role accepted. also i'll bring a small jar of raspberry jam because my tastebuds are dramatic.
Kevin: heads-up: parking by the launch is tight on weekends. might be worth a brief drop-off then move cars. i'll drive the slow convoy.
lunch-bot: Reminder: office fridge clean-out scheduled Monday 9am. Please label any personal items you want to keep.
Olga: labeling my kombucha 'Olga's super tonic (do not touch)' :label: :laughing:
Maya: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/morning-paddle-3o6ZsYhQ5dQ1g (mood)
Sam: sweet. see you all at 5:40 or at brunch if the fog steals the morning.
